(SPECIAL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION)
 FRIDAY, THE FIFTH DAY OF DECEMBER  TWO THOUSAND AND TWENTY FIVE  iPRESENT:
THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D RAMESH  WRIT PETITION NO: 33931 OF 2025 Between:
M / S.
Gas Authority Of India Limited, now called as GAIL (India) Limited (A  Government of India Undertaking), Having its regional office   Kattubadipalem, G.Konduru Mandal, Krishna District.
Rep. by its Chief  General Manager (O & M).
Petitione AND  1. The Competent Authority/Special Deputy Collector (LA), Gas Authority  of India Limited., Kattubadipalem, G.Konduru Mandal, Krishna District.
Respondent/Respondent No.1  2. A.Babu Rao, S/o. Kotaiah, Aged about 63 years, R/o. Guddamanugu  Village, G.Konduru Mandal, Krishna District.

Respondent/Petitioner No.2  Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased to issue an appropriate Writ or order or direction more particularly in the nature of Writ of Certiorari calling for the records of the Order dated 29.08.2025 passed by the Learned XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at Nuzvid in LAOP.No. 16/2017 and quash the same.

lA NO: 1 OF 2025  Petition under Section 151 CPC is filed praying that in  circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to suspend the operation of the order dated 29.08.2025 Kattubadipalem vs The Competent Authority/Special ... on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146768943/
1  passed by the Learned XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at Nuzvid  X in LAOP.No. 16/2017, Pending disposal of WP 33931 of 2025, on the file of the High Court.

The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of SRI LAKSHMI NARASIMHAM LANKA Advocate for the Petitioner, GP FOR LAND ACQUISITION for the Respondent No.1 and the Court made the following ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.
The writ petition is filed aggrieved by the order dated 29.08.2025 passed by the learned XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at Nuzvid, in L.A.O.P. No.16 of 2017.

entities.text: XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at Nuzvid
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Respondent No.1 herein was appointed as the competent authority for the purpose of acquiring land and determining compensation.
Based on the recommendations of the Horticulture and Forest Departments, the Competent authority assessed and fixed the value of the trees and crops standing in the subject property.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner had acquired land admeasuring Ac.0.46 cents in Sy.No.170/2 of Gaddamanugu Village, G. Konduru Mandal, Krishna District from the 2nd respondent, and that the assessing authority initially awarded a certain amount towards compensation for the subject property.

After receiving the said compensation, the 2nd respondent,
being dissatisfied with the quantum awarded, preferred L.A.O.P. No.16 of 2017 before the District Court under Section 10(1), (2), (3)(i), (ii) and (iii) of the Petroleum and Mineral Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962.

entities.text: Petroleum and Mineral Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Subsequently, the District Court enhanced the compensation to an amount of Rs.3,11,00,000/-.

It is contended that such enhancement is not supported by any fixed or approved valuation, and that the award passed by the learned District Judge is not in accordance with the proper valuation methodology.

Considering the submissions, there shali be a stay of all further proceedings pursuant to the order dated 29.08.2025 passed by the learned XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at NuZvid, in L.A.O.P. No.16of2017.

entities.text: XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at NuZvid
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice to the respondent No.2 through RPAD and file proof of service before the registry.
Post the matter after four (04) weeks.
SD/- K.J.RAJA BABU
